register_fpn_arch_default: register the default TestModel FPN architecture config with stages and combiners into the fpn_arch_factory registry
inspect_MODEL_ARCH_DEFAULT: inspect the MODEL_ARCH_DEFAULT dictionary to view TestModel stage definitions including conv_k1, noop, skip, conv_k3, and upsample stages
access_MODEL_ARCH_registry: access the MODEL_ARCH registry instance named fpn_arch_factory to look up registered FPN model architectures
customize_fpn_stages: customize the FPN stages list in MODEL_ARCH_DEFAULT to add new layer types like conv_k5 or change channel dimensions
modify_combiner_path: modify the combiner_path setting in MODEL_ARCH_DEFAULT from low_res to high_res to change feature fusion direction
